_about: Negation / polarity battery for the faithfulness auditor.
Ground truth is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION, not by annotation: for every pair the
`supported` claim is entailed by `doc`, and the `negated` claim contradicts it.
A checker that works must score supported > 0.5 and negated < 0.5.
This is a REGRESSION FIXTURE, not a throwaway. If either MiniCheck model is
ever changed, re-run `python -m missing_link.audit battery` and compare against
docs/audit-ledger.md before adopting the new model.
Documents are deliberately SHORT (one to three sentences). That isolates the
polarity question: there is no redundant restatement elsewhere in the document
to rescue a checker that has misread the obligation. It is the hard case, and
the spike (docs/minicheck-spike.md section 5) explicitly could not tell whether
length and redundancy were what saved the one real-data row.
Categories match the clause types this project's real material is made of:
Pairs 1, 6, 7, 11 and 12 are the five from docs/minicheck-spike.md section 4,
kept verbatim so the spike's result stays reproducible inside the larger battery.

pairs.doc: Clinical records must be retained for seven years from the date of last service, or until the client turns twenty-five, whichever is later.
pairs.supported: Records must be kept for seven years from the last service.
pairs.negated: Records must not be retained beyond seven years from the last service.

pairs.doc: Records relating to a client who was a minor at the time of service must be retained until the client's twenty-fifth birthday.
pairs.supported: Records for clients who were minors must be kept until they turn twenty-five.
pairs.negated: Records for clients who were minors may be destroyed before they turn twenty-five.

pairs.doc: Financial records supporting the annual acquittal must be retained for five years after the end of the funding period.
pairs.supported: Financial acquittal records must be kept for five years after the funding period ends.
pairs.negated: Financial acquittal records need not be kept once the funding period ends.

pairs.doc: CCTV footage from the reception area is retained for thirty days and is then automatically overwritten.
pairs.supported: Reception CCTV footage is kept for thirty days before it is overwritten.
pairs.negated: Reception CCTV footage is retained indefinitely and is never overwritten.

pairs.doc: Corporate email is archived for seven years. The personal mailboxes of departed staff are deleted after ninety days.
pairs.supported: The mailboxes of departed staff are deleted after ninety days.
pairs.negated: The mailboxes of departed staff are archived for seven years alongside corporate email.

pairs.doc: Incident reports were stored on a shared drive with permissions inherited from a parent folder, granting read access to 41 staff who had no clinical role.
pairs.supported: 41 non-clinical staff had read access to the incident reports.
pairs.negated: No non-clinical staff had read access to the incident reports.

pairs.doc: Staff may access archived records only with written authorisation from the clinical director.
pairs.supported: Access to archived records requires written authorisation from the clinical director.
pairs.negated: Staff may access archived records without authorisation from the clinical director.

pairs.doc: External contractors are granted read-only access to the case management system and cannot amend or delete records.
pairs.supported: Contractors can read case records but cannot change them.
pairs.negated: Contractors may amend and delete records in the case management system.

pairs.doc: Remote access to the clinical database is disabled between 10 pm and 6 am for all users other than the on-call clinician.
pairs.supported: Between 10 pm and 6 am only the on-call clinician can reach the clinical database remotely.
pairs.negated: All users keep remote access to the clinical database between 10 pm and 6 am.

pairs.doc: The reporting account password was shared among team members, contrary to policy, until it was rotated in April 2026.
pairs.supported: A shared password was in use until April 2026.
pairs.negated: The reporting account password was never shared between team members.

pairs.doc: The provider must notify the regulator within 72 hours of becoming aware of a data breach affecting client records.
pairs.supported: The provider is required to notify the regulator within 72 hours of a breach.
pairs.negated: The provider is not required to notify the regulator following a data breach.

pairs.doc: Records subject to a litigation hold must not be destroyed while the hold remains in effect.
pairs.supported: Records under litigation hold may not be destroyed while the hold is in effect.
pairs.negated: Records under litigation hold may be destroyed at any time, including during a hold.

pairs.doc: A staff member who forms a reasonable belief that a child has suffered harm must report that belief to the department on the same day.
pairs.supported: Staff must report a reasonable belief that a child has suffered harm to the department on the same day.
pairs.negated: Staff are not obliged to report a reasonable belief that a child has suffered harm.

pairs.doc: Board members must declare any material personal interest before the matter is discussed.
pairs.supported: A board member must declare a material personal interest before the matter is discussed.
pairs.negated: Board members may take part in the discussion without declaring a material personal interest.

pairs.doc: The organisation is required to lodge an annual information statement with the regulator within six months of the end of its financial year.
pairs.supported: An annual information statement must be lodged with the regulator within six months of the end of the financial year.
pairs.negated: The organisation is exempt from lodging an annual information statement with the regulator.

pairs.doc: A complaint must be acknowledged in writing within three business days and resolved within twenty-eight days.
pairs.supported: A complaint must be resolved within twenty-eight days.
pairs.negated: There is no fixed time limit for resolving a complaint.

pairs.doc: An applicant may appeal a decision within twenty-one days of receiving the written reasons.
pairs.supported: An appeal may be lodged within twenty-one days of receiving the written reasons.
pairs.negated: An appeal may be lodged at any time, with no limit on how long after the written reasons are received.

pairs.doc: Invoices are payable thirty days from the date of issue, and interest accrues on any amount outstanding after that date.
pairs.supported: Invoices must be paid within thirty days of the date of issue.
pairs.negated: Invoices are not due until ninety days from the date of issue.

pairs.doc: The service must respond to audit findings within fourteen days of receiving the draft report.
pairs.supported: A response to the audit findings is due within fourteen days of receiving the draft report.
pairs.negated: The service is not required to respond to the audit findings within any set period.

pairs.doc: The regulator granted an extension to 30 June 2026 for submission of the remediation plan.
pairs.supported: The deadline for submitting the remediation plan was extended to 30 June 2026.
pairs.negated: The regulator refused to extend the deadline for submitting the remediation plan.

pairs.doc: The consent requirement does not apply to de-identified data used for internal service planning.
pairs.supported: De-identified data used for internal service planning is exempt from the consent requirement.
pairs.negated: Consent is required for de-identified data used for internal service planning.

pairs.doc: Organisations with an annual turnover of three million dollars or less are exempt from the reporting obligation, unless they provide a health service.
pairs.supported: A small organisation that provides a health service is not exempt from the reporting obligation.
pairs.negated: Every organisation with a turnover of three million dollars or less is exempt from the reporting obligation.

pairs.doc: Disclosure without consent is permitted only where there is a serious and imminent threat to life or health.
pairs.supported: Disclosure without consent is permitted where there is a serious and imminent threat to life or health.
pairs.negated: Disclosure without consent is prohibited in all circumstances, including a serious and imminent threat to life.

pairs.doc: Documents subject to legal professional privilege are excluded from the production order.
pairs.supported: Privileged documents do not have to be produced under the order.
pairs.negated: Documents subject to legal professional privilege must be produced under the order.

pairs.doc: Research use of client records requires ethics committee approval. Quality assurance activities carried out within the service do not.
pairs.supported: Quality assurance activities within the service do not need ethics committee approval.
pairs.negated: Quality assurance activities within the service require ethics committee approval.

pairs.doc: Records must not be transferred to a third party unless the client has given written consent.
pairs.supported: Transferring records to a third party requires the client's written consent.
pairs.negated: Records may be transferred to a third party without the client's written consent.

pairs.doc: All incidents must be entered in the register within 24 hours, except where the incident is under police investigation, in which case entry is deferred until the investigation concludes.
pairs.supported: Entry in the register is deferred while an incident is under police investigation.
pairs.negated: An incident under police investigation must still be entered in the register within 24 hours.

pairs.doc: Staff may administer medication only if they have completed the medication competency assessment in the last twelve months.
pairs.supported: Only staff who completed the medication competency assessment in the last twelve months may administer medication.
pairs.negated: Any staff member may administer medication regardless of the competency assessment.

pairs.doc: Where the client is under sixteen, consent must be obtained from a parent or guardian in addition to the client.
pairs.supported: For a client under sixteen, consent is needed from a parent or guardian as well as from the client.
pairs.negated: For a client under sixteen, the client's own consent is sufficient.

pairs.doc: The additional outreach position will be created subject to continued funding beyond June 2027.
pairs.supported: Creation of the outreach position depends on funding continuing beyond June 2027.
pairs.negated: The outreach position will be created whether or not funding continues beyond June 2027.

pairs.doc: All staff, including volunteers and contractors, completed the annual privacy training in February 2026.
pairs.supported: Volunteers and contractors completed the annual privacy training in February 2026.
pairs.negated: No volunteers or contractors completed the annual privacy training.

pairs.doc: Three of the twelve sampled files contained a signed consent form.
pairs.supported: Three sampled files contained a signed consent form.
pairs.negated: All twelve sampled files contained a signed consent form.

pairs.doc: No breaches were reported to the regulator during the 2025 financial year.
pairs.supported: There were no breaches reported to the regulator in the 2025 financial year.
pairs.negated: Several breaches were reported to the regulator during the 2025 financial year.

pairs.doc: Only two of the seven sites have implemented automated archival.
pairs.supported: Automated archival is in place at two of the seven sites.
pairs.negated: Automated archival has been implemented at all seven sites.

pairs.doc: Following remediation, access was reduced from 41 staff to 6 staff who hold a clinical role.
pairs.supported: After remediation, six staff with a clinical role retained access.
pairs.negated: After remediation, all 41 staff retained access.

pairs.doc: Every incident recorded in 2025 was closed within the target timeframe, apart from one that remained open at year end.
pairs.supported: One incident recorded in 2025 was still open at year end.
pairs.negated: All incidents recorded in 2025 were closed within the target timeframe.
